Package com.apfelkomplott.apfelkomplott.engine

Class RoundEngine

java.lang.Object
com.apfelkomplott.apfelkomplott.engine.RoundEngine
@Component public class RoundEngine extends Object
Coordinates the ordered phases of a game round and delegates rule-specific work to the corresponding services.

    • runNextPhase

      public void runNextPhase(GameState state)
      Advances the supplied game state to the next phase.

      Some phases intentionally stop after calculating a result so that the frontend can display a popup before the player continues.

      Parameters:
      state - mutable game state to progress
